events.title: Field & Main Bank Buys Shares of 19,373 Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. $AMD
events.summary: Field & Main Bank has acquired a new stake in Advanced Micro Devices (AMD), purchasing 19,373 shares valued at approximately $11.25 million, making it their 13th largest holding. This move comes as AMD reports strong quarterly results with revenue up 50.1% year-over-year and analysts maintaining a "Moderate Buy" rating, despite concerns over valuation, competition from Nvidia, and recent insider selling. Institutional investors now collectively own 71.34% of AMD, reflecting significant interest alongside ongoing market scrutiny.

events.title: Whalen Wealth Management Inc. Invests $1.51 Million in Intel Corporation $INTC
events.summary: Whalen Wealth Management Inc. has invested $1.51 million in Intel Corporation by acquiring 10,841 shares in Q2 2026. This comes as Intel reported stronger-than-expected quarterly results, with CEO Lip-Bu Tan also signaling confidence through a nearly $10 million stock purchase. Despite mixed analyst sentiment, institutional investors now own 64.53% of the company, with discussions around foundry contracts and AI opportunities influencing its future.

events.title: Van ECK Associates Corp Sells 2,592,368 Shares of Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. $AMD
events.summary: Van ECK Associates Corp has reduced its stake in Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) by 21.5%, selling over 2.59 million shares but still retaining a significant holding valued at $5.51 billion. Despite this sale and recent insider selling, analysts generally maintain a "Moderate Buy" rating for AMD with an average price target of $553.72, following a quarter where the company exceeded revenue and EPS estimates. However, there are growing valuation concerns and increased competition noted by some analysts.

events.title: Tairen Capital Ltd Purchases Shares of 469,340 Intel Corporation $INTC
events.summary: Tairen Capital Ltd recently acquired 469,340 shares of Intel Corporation (NASDAQ:INTC) during the second quarter, valuing the new position at approximately $65.5 million and making it the sixth-largest holding in their portfolio. This move comes as other institutional investors also adjusted their stakes in Intel, and CEO Lip-Bu Tan increased his personal holdings, signaling confidence. Despite beating earnings and revenue estimates, analyst sentiment for Intel remains mixed, with an average "Hold" rating.

events.title: Osmosis Investment Management UK Ltd Acquires New Holdings in Intel Corporation $INTC
events.summary: Osmosis Investment Management UK Ltd has acquired a new position in Intel Corporation, purchasing 177,563 shares valued at approximately $24.79 million, making Intel its 14th largest holding. This news comes amidst other institutional investors modifying their holdings and positive sentiment regarding Intel's foundry recovery and AI opportunities, alongside recent insider buying by CEO Lip Bu Tan. The article also provides financial performance data, analyst ratings, and company information for Intel.

events.title: L2 Asset Management LLC Invests $3.27 Million in Intel Corporation $INTC
events.summary: L2 Asset Management LLC recently invested $3.27 million in Intel Corporation, acquiring 23,444 shares during the second quarter, making them one of many institutional investors holding 64.53% of the company. Despite analyst caution with a "Hold" rating, Intel's CEO Lip-Bu Tan increased his stake by 8.7% with a $10 million purchase, signaling confidence. The company also surpassed quarterly revenue and EPS expectations.

events.title: Toth Financial Advisory Corp Reduces Holdings in Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. $AMD
events.summary: Toth Financial Advisory Corp significantly reduced its holdings in Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) by 81.9% in the second quarter, selling 6,400 shares and retaining 1,410 shares valued at $819,000. Despite this, institutional investors collectively own a substantial 71.34% of AMD, and analysts generally maintain a "Moderate Buy" rating with an average price target of $553.72. The company's recent strong revenue growth of 50.1% year-over-year to $11.54 billion and exceeding EPS expectations are balanced against concerns regarding high valuation, rising bond yields, competition from Nvidia, and insider share sales.

events.title: VMware wants to become the enterprise home for AI agents
events.summary: VMware, under Broadcom, is positioning its VMware Private AI Cloud on VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) as the enterprise solution for AI agents, aiming to convince customers to keep AI workloads within their ecosystem. The strategy emphasizes running AI privately for cost savings, leveraging existing hardware, efficient GPU utilization, and on-premises data preparation. The company made seven key announcements at Explore 2026, focusing on security, governance, and a platform for "untrusted" AI agents, while acknowledging that many new AI capabilities will be separately licensed add-ons to the VCF subscription.

events.title: Why Did Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOGL) Shares Just Tumble on Executive News?
events.summary: Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOGL) shares tumbled after news of a senior AI researcher's departure to start a new venture, coupled with a broader reshuffle in the company's AI division. This executive news caused the stock to fall through a near-term support zone, raising questions about the company's ability to maintain its competitive edge in the AI race despite strong performance from its core search and cloud businesses. The market reaction highlights sensitivity to talent retention in the rapidly evolving generative computing sector.

events.title: Micron Stock Offers More Than A Market Ride
events.summary: Micron Technology (MU) stock has shown strong independent growth, outperforming the S&P 500 with an annualized return of 69% over five years due to its unique business model transformation. The company is securing multi-year "take or pay" strategic customer agreements for AI memory chips, aiming to stabilize its notoriously cyclical industry with guaranteed floor prices and robust gross margins. This strategy positions Micron as a differentiated return engine for portfolios, offering growth driven by specific AI demand rather than general market trends, despite increased volatility.

events.title: A look inside Apple’s relationships with Intel and TSMC
events.summary: This article examines Apple's complex relationships with chip manufacturers Intel and TSMC, highlighting how a lack of trust led Apple to move away from Intel and embrace TSMC. It discusses Intel's struggles to regain Apple's business due to issues like a perceived lack of commitment to manufacturing capacity and prematurely discussing potential deals. In contrast, TSMC's strong emphasis on trust, continuous investment in advanced technology, and discretion have solidified its position as Apple's preferred supplier.

events.title: Berenberg initiates HawkEye 360 stock with buy on defense demand
events.summary: Berenberg has initiated coverage on HawkEye 360 Inc. (NYSE:HAWK) with a Buy rating and a price target of $24.00, citing strong demand in defense and the company's unique position in commercial radio-frequency signals intelligence. Despite a recent stock decline, Berenberg highlights HawkEye 360's significant organic growth, high gross margins, and expanding EBITDA margins, driven by increased government spending on electronic warfare. The company also reported an 87% revenue increase in Q2 2026, though it faced a wider net loss due to public market transition costs.

events.title: Apple to Mac developers: It’s time to let go of Intel
events.summary: Apple has informed developers that they can now discontinue support for Intel-based Macs for universal macOS apps requiring macOS 13 or later. This move follows Apple's introduction of M-series chips nearly six years ago and its announcement that macOS 26 Tahoe would be the last version to support Intel Macs. Developers will need to assess their user base to determine when to fully transition away from Intel code, especially since macOS 27 will no longer run Intel-only apps on Apple silicon.

events.title: Intel reverses course, will keep ownership of 162-acre Folsom campus
events.summary: Intel Corp. has decided to reverse its previous plans and will retain ownership of its 161.8-acre Folsom campus, which includes 1.68 million square feet of office space. This decision marks a significant change from an earlier intention to sell and lease back the property. The Folsom campus remains a key asset for Intel.

events.title: Prediction: Intel Stock Could Have a Major Catalyst Ahead
events.summary: Intel's stock has seen a dramatic reversal, with a 267.6% increase over the past year due to its 18A ramp, NVIDIA investment, and AI-driven data center growth. 24/7 Wall St. has a buy recommendation and a $101.53 price target for Intel, citing strong Q2 2026 results where revenue grew 25.42% and data center/AI revenue jumped 59%. The company faces challenges like foundry operating losses and mixed analyst sentiment, but its turnaround potential and lower relative multiple compared to NVIDIA and AMD make its future outlook promising.

events.title: QT Imaging Holdings (NASDAQ: QTI) Awards CEO Dr. Raluca Dinu 484,221 Restricted Stock Units with Vesting Through 2030
events.summary: QT Imaging Holdings (NASDAQ: QTI) has granted its CEO, Dr. Raluca Dinu, 484,221 restricted stock units under its 2024 Amended and Restated Equity Incentive Plan. This award is tied to Dr. Dinu's continued service, with vesting scheduled through February 15, 2030, and the first tranche vesting on November 15, 2026. The grant was approved by the Compensation Committee and requires ongoing service for vesting at each scheduled date.

events.title: Intel shuts down Israel AI lab
events.summary: Intel is closing its agentic and inference optimization research laboratories in Israel, resulting in 13 layoffs. The company cited organizational considerations based on geographical location for the decision, which is part of a broader streamlining and restructuring program under CEO Lip-Bu Tan. This move is unusual for the industry, as other tech giants are aggressively investing in AI research.

events.title: Intel pivots: Folsom campus not for sale
events.summary: Intel has reversed its decision to sell its Folsom campus, indicating a strategic pivot for the company. This news comes after previous considerations to divest the property. The Folsom campus will remain under Intel's ownership.
